name: Home, Academy tab
alt: The old Mara app home on Android, Academy tab: total balance ₦2,896, a row of article cards and a row of video cards, cut off by the floating bottom bar
note: A pasted device screenshot of the old app, so it is exported whole and not coded. Drawn in Figma at 306x680 with 12px rounded corners; export.png is the image fill itself at its original 1080x2400 (the fill is uncropped, same proportions as the box), square-cornered, decoded from the JPEG Figma holds and saved lossless, with its colour profile kept. image.webp is the same pixels as lossless WebP. One change from the source: the white caption strip on the third video thumbnail, which carried part of a real person's name, is painted plain white (2026-10-08).
